summary: Frontend-only E2E verification of WhatsApp OTP flows on both Hero form (prefix 'lead-') and Enquiry dialog (prefix 'modal-'). All 7 specified flows pass. Used real number 9289505505 only; stayed within 4-submission budget (3 /api/leads POSTs this run + 1 from a prior crashed run on the first POST, so 4 total WhatsApp sends — no resend clicks). 1) Validation: mobile '12345' client-blocked (HTML5 minLength=10) — 0 /api/leads POST. 2) Hero: POST returned 201 with debug_otp exposed; OTP step heading 'Verify Your WhatsApp Number', subtext contains '+91 92XXX XX505', notice 'OTP sent to your WhatsApp', countdown 'Resend OTP in 30s'; wrong OTP 000000 → error 'Incorrect OTP. Please check the code and try again.'; correct OTP → lead-thank-you with 'Thank You! Your Bali enquiry has been received. Our travel expert will contact you shortly.' GET /api/leads newest 'QA Hero' lead: otp_status='verified', form_source='Hero Form', package='Custom Bali Trip', mobile='9289505505'. 3) Package modal: package-quote-btn-0 → dialog titled 'Get a Quote for Bali Escape'; modal-* submission; change-number flow (modal-change-number-btn → modal-change-number screen → modal-new-mobile-input → modal-change-number-submit → new debug_otp 200) → modal-thank-you. DB: single 'QA Modal' record with otp_status='verified', form_source='Package Popup', package='Bali Escape'. 4) Abandon via header-enquire-btn → submit → close via enquiry-dialog-close. DB: 'QA Abandon' lead with otp_status='unverified', otp_send_status='sent', form_source='Header CTA'. 5) Security: POST /api/leads, resend/change-number responses, and GET /api/leads JSON contain NO 'a730ab', 'authkey', 'otp_hash', or 'promotionkart'. Fetched served JS bundles (main.tsx + others): no 'promotionkart' or 'a730ab'. 6) Mobile 390px: hero form bodySW=390/CW=390, formSW=316/CW=316 → no horizontal overflow. All data-testids present and resolve as spec'd.
critical_code_review_comments: LeadForm.tsx submitError() only handles 422 and 429; a 400 from backend (e.g. OTP send provider failure before lead save, or malformed payload) will fall back to the generic 'Could not submit…' message losing the actual backend detail. Consider surfacing detail string for any 4xx with JSON {detail: string}.

OtpStep.tsx: when wrong OTP is entered and the user starts editing a box, otp state is reset only when onChange fires with a new value — the existing digits remain visible until typing. Minor UX: clear all boxes on verify-error so the user retypes fresh. Currently works but requires manual clearing (tests had to explicitly empty each digit box before retyping).

LeadForm success case transitions via onSuccess regardless of body.otp_sent flag. If the provider ever reports otp_sent=false (which OtpStep already handles by showing the message in the error slot), the user still lands on the OTP step with no code sent — relies on correctly reading state.otp_sent to avoid cooldown confusion. The current impl correctly sets cooldown=0 in that case, so this is informational.
Backend returns 201 Created for POST /api/leads (correct REST). No action — just noting any frontend code or docs stating '200' is inaccurate.
seed_data_creation: Created 4 leads via UI during run with mobile 9289505505: 'QA Hero' x1 verified (Hero Form, Custom Bali Trip), 'QA Modal' x1 verified (Package Popup, Bali Escape; change-number used), 'QA Abandon' x1 unverified (Header CTA, otp_send_status=sent). Also 1 stale 'QA Hero' unverified lead from a prior crashed run (first POST succeeded before script assertion failed). All used 9289505505 as required.
context_for_next_testing_agent: POST /api/leads returns HTTP 201 (not 200). Response schema: {lead_id, otp_status, otp_sent, masked_mobile:'+91 92XXX XX505', resend_cooldown_seconds, resends_left, message, debug_otp} — only when OTP_DEBUG_EXPOSE=true in preview. Change-number endpoint returns 200. Capture debug_otp with page.expect_response — NOT exposed in UI. Masked format uses literal 'XXX XX' with spaces, so assert substring '+91 92XXX XX505'. Base UI selects open via click on trigger ({prefix}-select-month/travelers) and options have data-testid {prefix}-month-option / {prefix}-travelers-option (option scoped by has_text). Hero form submission button test-id is 'lead-form-submit-button' and modal is 'modal-form-submit-button'. Rate limit is 8 OTP sends/IP/10min — stay well under. ThankYou component outputs text that renders without space between title and body: 'Thank You!Your Bali enquiry has been received…' (no separator) — substring match works. Backend lead fields include: otp_status, otp_send_status, otp_verified_at, created_at — safe to filter by name. No ObjectId leaks.
